name: Cerulean / Misty
objective: Prepare for and defeat Misty while respecting safe strategic and constraint directives.

allowed_randomization.hp_policy: At least one Pokemon must be conscious. Degraded starts may include low HP, status, or one fainted backup.
allowed_randomization.map_policy: Use target-map template states only. Same-map coordinate nudges are allowed. Cross-map WRAM-only teleports are not allowed.
allowed_randomization.story_flags: Cascade Badge must be absent at start unless the state is used only as a post-success evaluator control.

valid_start_requirements: State loads through PyBoy and produces an inspectable snapshot.
Player is in Cerulean City, Cerulean PokeCenter, or Cerulean Gym.
Boulder Badge is expected; Cascade Badge is absent for normal starts.
At least one party Pokemon is conscious.
impossible_or_degraded_starts: Soft directive such as avoid overleveling the starter.
Battle already in progress with constrained resources.
success_conditions: Cascade Badge is detected in the final state.
The player does not black out.
The final state is inspectable and stable.
failure_conditions: Cascade Badge is not obtained before timeout.
A measurable accepted constraint is violated.
The executor loops in menu, dialogue, or battle without progress.
The executor leaves the Cerulean-relevant region without a recovery reason.
A destructive directive or action is accepted.
abort_conditions: State violates core invariants before the first action.
The evaluator cannot inspect party, inventory, map, mode, or badges.
The state requires unpromoted story/event flags.
evaluator_notes: Cascade Badge detection is the clean automated v0 success signal.
Overlevel constraints are measurable from final and intermediate party levels once run logs exist.
